_meta.description: Historical Airbnb trip data for the Edgerton, OH area, sourced from Gmail confirmation + review emails. See README.md 'Refreshing the historical dataset' for how to re-run this sweep.
_meta.searchArea: Within roughly an hour's drive of Edgerton, OH in any direction — covers Williams County OH (Bryan, Hicksville) and the adjacent northeast Indiana towns people actually book when visiting the area (Auburn, Fort Wayne, Avilla).
_meta.confirmationMethod: A trip is only counted as 'used' if both a booking confirmation email AND a matching post-stay review email (host review of guest, and/or the 'write a review' prompt to guest) were found in Gmail. Bookings with no matching review email, or with an explicit cancellation email, are listed under unconfirmedTrips instead of trips.
_meta.refreshNote: The first pass at this dataset only searched for Ohio town names near Edgerton and found one trip. Re-running with 'search everything, then filter by distance' instead of 'search by keyword' turned up 4 more confirmed trips plus 3 cancelled attempts, all in nearby northeast Indiana. Search by destination keyword only for towns you already know matter — for an area this rural, pull every trip in the window first and filter by distance after.
